projects.name: Bregman Adaptive Nonconvex Decoupled Algorithm for Convolutional Dictionary Learning (BANDA)
projects.summary: Corresponding to Knowledge-Based Systems (2026) | Core Method: BANDA
highlights: Background: Addressed the issue that alternating minimization in traditional slice-based L0-constrained convolutional dictionary learning (CDL) easily gets trapped in poor local minima due to high non-convexity and non-smoothness.

Theoretical & Algorithmic Contributions: Independently derived customized Legendre kernel functions to reduce complex non-convex proximal subproblems into closed-form solutions via univariate cubic equations, and established rigorous convergence guarantees under the Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz (KL) property and L-smad condition.
Experiments & Writing: Implemented MATLAB benchmarks for image reconstruction and denoising, and led English manuscript drafting, visualization, and peer-review revisions.

projects.name: Structured Sparse Representation Learning with Locality-Preserving Strict Sparsity and Spatially Adaptive Geometry (VBASTA)
projects.summary: Corresponding to Pattern Recognition (2026) | Core Method: VBASTA
highlights: Background: Resolved the limitation of uniform scalar step sizes in convolutional dictionary learning when handling spatially heterogeneous patch overlaps.

Theoretical & Algorithmic Contributions: Proposed a variable-metric diagonal majorizer based on the Gershgorin circle theorem to avoid Hessian matrix inversion, implemented backtracking line search in MATLAB, and proved sufficient decrease guarantees.
Experiments & Writing: Led visual restoration experiments, quantitative evaluations, and core manuscript writing.
